sources.title: Jeesup/svd-safety-l3_swift_remove20 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Jeesup/svd-safety-l3_swift_remove20 is an 8 billion parameter Llama-3-8B-Instruct model that has undergone significant compression and recovery. It was created by Jeesup using Swift-SVD for compression, reducing its parameters to 80% of the original, followed by recovery using SVD-LLM's stage-2 LoRA.

sources.title: Jeesup/svd-safety-l3_swift_remove40 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: Overview This model, svd-safety-l3_swift_remove40, is an 8 billion parameter Llama-2-7b-chat checkpoint that has undergone SVD-LLM compression, resulting in 60% of its original dense parameters. It is a research artifact from a study investigating the effects of SVD compression on model safety and the efficacy of various component-selection rules for restoring safety.
